candidate_sentence_map.S3: This revenue growth was driven by strong performance in the Americas, which remained the largest market, and stabilization in Pakistan, the group’s main production base.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Despite currency headwinds from a weakening US dollar and Pakistani Rupee in the first half of the year, the company delivered double-digit growth, the first since its consolidation phase began.

candidate_sentence_map.S8: However, net earnings after tax improved substantially, rising 42 percent to EUR 0.9 million from EUR 0.6 million, leading to an EAT margin of 4.8 percent versus 3.8 percent in the previous period.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: The improvement in net earnings occurred despite management noting that initial investments in future growth created temporary pressure on margins.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: The company prioritizes recurring engagements to generate predictable cash flows, a strategy that supported this financial resilience.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Several key business events influenced these results.

candidate_sentence_map.S13: The company shifted its geographic focus toward developed markets, particularly Western Europe, while maintaining a strong presence in the Americas.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: In Germany, Talkpool continued to support Deutsche Telekom’s fiber rollout, although a shift in the operator’s priorities led to a temporary flattening of planning assignment volumes.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: In Pakistan, the company renegotiated commercial terms with major customers in the second half of the year, resulting in improved gross profitability.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Additionally, Talkpool supported Digicel in restoring communications infrastructure in Jamaica following Hurricane Melissa, highlighting the strength of its long-term client relationships.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The balance sheet strengthened significantly during the period.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Equity improved by EUR 4.6 million to EUR 2.1 million, moving from a negative position in 2021.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Net cash position also turned positive, reaching EUR 0.3 million by year-end, an improvement of EUR 6.0 million from 2021.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: This financial stability allowed the company to receive an unqualified audit opinion regarding going concern, a major milestone.
candidate_sentence_map.S21: Management expects near-term pressure on cash flow and margins due to strategic investments in technology and personnel, particularly in AI-powered remote services and the US market entry.
candidate_sentence_map.S22: However, organic growth accelerated throughout the year, exceeding 20 percent by year-end, signaling a robust foundation for future expansion.
candidate_sentence_map.S23: The company is now positioned to leverage its low-cost delivery model from Pakistan and emerging AI solutions to capture value in the growing telecom services market.

factual_claims.source_evidence: In 2025, Talkpool ended its multi-year 'reduce to the MAX' focus and started to grow. After years of minimizing all kinds of costs and risks, the company hired personnel and made first investments in line with a new Vision 2030.

factual_claims.claim: The company achieved net sales of EUR 17.8 million, representing a 12.5 percent increase from EUR 15.8 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Net sales amounted to EUR 17 756 thousand (EUR 15 782 thousand in 2024), representing an increase of 12.5 percent

factual_claims.claim: This revenue growth was driven by strong performance in the Americas, which remained the largest market, and stabilization in Pakistan, the group’s main production base.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Americas remained Talkpool’s largest market, with strong business momentum continuing throughout the year despite US dollar weakness... Pakistan established as the Group’s main production base

factual_claims.claim: Despite currency headwinds from a weakening US dollar and Pakistani Rupee in the first half of the year, the company delivered double-digit growth, the first since its consolidation phase began.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Currency headwinds in the first half of 2025 - with the US dollar weakening by 11% and the PKR (Pakistani Rupees) by 14%... Full-year revenues grew 12.5% to EUR 17.8 million — the first year of double-digit growth since the consolidation phase started.

factual_claims.claim: Profitability metrics showed mixed but generally positive trends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBITDA margin of 10.3 percent (10.8), EBIT margin of 9.1 percent (9.7), Net earnings after tax... an increase of 42%

factual_claims.claim: The improvement in net earnings occurred despite management noting that initial investments in future growth created temporary pressure on margins.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management expects temporary margin pressure as initial investments are required to generate more profitable business... Nearterm pressure on cash flow and margins is anticipated

factual_claims.claim: The company prioritizes recurring engagements to generate predictable cash flows, a strategy that supported this financial resilience.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The company prioritizes recurring engagements, which generate predictable and stable cash flows.

factual_claims.claim: Several key business events influenced these results.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Talkpool ended its "reduce to the MAX" cost-cutting focus and launched the Vision 2030 Strategic Growth Plan in April, targeting EUR 40 million in revenues and a 14 percent EBITDA margin by 2030.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In 2025, Talkpool ended its multi-year “reduce to the MAX” focus and started to grow... Long-term 2030 targets of EUR 40 million in revenues and 14% EBITDA margin were published in April 2025

factual_claims.claim: The company shifted its geographic focus toward developed markets, particularly Western Europe, while maintaining a strong presence in the Americas.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Historically, Talkpool’s Telecom Network Services business was oriented toward developing markets. The company has shifted its geographic focus towards developed markets, currently concentrating primarily on western Europe... Americas remained Talkpool’s largest market

factual_claims.claim: In Germany, Talkpool continued to support Deutsche Telekom’s fiber rollout, although a shift in the operator’s priorities led to a temporary flattening of planning assignment volumes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: During 2025, however, a shift in the operator’s rollout priorities — with greater emphasis on homes "passed" rather than connected — led to a temporary flattening of planning assignment volumes.

factual_claims.claim: In Pakistan, the company renegotiated commercial terms with major customers in the second half of the year, resulting in improved gross profitability.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: In the second half of 2025, it successfully renegotiated commercial terms with all major customers, resulting in a meaningful improvement in gross profitability.

factual_claims.claim: Additionally, Talkpool supported Digicel in restoring communications infrastructure in Jamaica following Hurricane Melissa, highlighting the strength of its long-term client relationships.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Talkpool supported Digicel in restoring Jamaica’s communications infrastructure following Hurricane Melissa.

factual_claims.claim: The balance sheet strengthened significantly during the period.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Equity has improved by EUR 4.6 million from -EUR 2.5 million in 2021 to EUR 2.1 million in 2025... Net Cash has improved by EUR 6.0 million, from -EUR 5.7 million in 2021 to reaching a positive position of EUR 0.3 million

factual_claims.claim: This financial stability allowed the company to receive an unqualified audit opinion regarding going concern, a major milestone.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: After years of focused balance sheet repair and cash flow improvement, our auditors do no longer express an uncertainty in respect to our ability of going concern in their Auditors’reports

factual_claims.claim: Management expects near-term pressure on cash flow and margins due to strategic investments in technology and personnel, particularly in AI-powered remote services and the US market entry.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Nearterm pressure on cash flow and margins is anticipated, but new business activity is expected to drive both to new levels within the next 12 months... management expects temporary margin pressure as initial investments are required

factual_claims.claim: However, organic growth accelerated throughout the year, exceeding 20 percent by year-end, signaling a robust foundation for future expansion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Organic growth accelerated throughout the year, reaching the 16.8% long-term growth target by year-end... Organic growth at the end of 2025 exceeded 20%

factual_claims.claim: The company is now positioned to leverage its low-cost delivery model from Pakistan and emerging AI solutions to capture value in the growing telecom services market.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Talkpool Pakistan offers remote services at EUR 6 per hour — approximately ten times lower than equivalent costs in developed markets... The first AI-powered technology solutions underwent trials and proof-of-concept testing during 2025
